data.summary: A multi-tenant project-management SaaS: each tenant's users manage Projects and attached Invoice documents. Demonstrates the SAME template library used for the auth-only express-neon-s3-app example, reused for a structurally different domain — tenant-scoped entities, role-based access, and a Next.js frontend (artifact-only in this example; frontend.* code-generation templates are not yet implemented, see frontend.schema.json).

entities.name: Invoice
entities.description: A tenant-scoped billing document, optionally with an attached PDF in object storage.

features.title: CRUD Projects, scoped to the caller's tenant
CRUD Invoices, scoped to the caller's tenant, admin-only delete
Attach a PDF to an Invoice via private object storage
Filter/sort the Project and Invoice lists

constraints: Cross-tenant data access must be impossible even under an application bug, not just prevented by the UI
